scope.description: The deck page name + id, the slide boards scored, and the exports the scores cite.

deckStyle.description: The committed profile from references/02-deck-styles.md, e.g. 'Tech-dark-gradient'.

tonalArc.description: The committed arc, e.g. 'dark cover/sections/closing, light body'.

motif.description: The one repeated device, e.g. 'oversized numerals'.

evidence.description: What in the slide exports justifies the score, naming slides. A score without visible evidence is invalid.

fix.description: Required when score < 3: the concrete revision (which slides, what changes).

axes.description: Exactly one entry per axis, scored against the per-slide exports (references/07-critique-framework.md).

consecutiveRepeats.description: Pairs of consecutive slides with the same archetype. Target 0.

maxArchetypeShare.description: Share of the deck taken by the most used archetype. Target ≤ 0.4.

anchorAlternation.description: Share of consecutive slide pairs whose anchor point differs.

pass.description: auditDeckQuality.js verdict — the field brief-to-deck's branch condition reads together with belowThreshold.

belowThreshold.description: Count of axes with score < 3 — read by brief-to-deck's branch condition.

id.description: Stable within the run, e.g. dk-composition-01. Reused across iterations when the same issue recurs.

tell.description: A named tell from shared/design-quality.md §7 or references/02-deck-styles.md 'what to refuse', reported verbatim.

slide.description: Board name of the slide (NN-archetype-slug). Empty for deck-level findings.

safeSet.description: true only if the fix is in the auto-apply safe set (policies/modes.json). Renaming a slide board is; everything else is not.

exceptions.description: Literal values the API cannot bind to tokens (gradients, glass fills, shadows) and failed image uploads, mirrored from the run ledger.

truncation.description: Non-empty when scope was capped/sampled — no silent truncation (AGENTS.md §12).
